resources.name: Georgia Crisis and Access Line (GCAL)
resources.notes: 24/7 statewide line for mental health, substance use, and developmental disability crises. Penny should gently steer people here if they mention a crisis.

resources.name: Find a Community Service Board (CSB)
resources.notes: State-managed directory of Community Service Boards across Georgia. Use this instead of naming local CSBs manually.

resources.name: Georgia Department of Public Health – STD Program
resources.notes: State program that supports STD testing and treatment across all 159 Georgia counties.

resources.name: Fulton County Board of Health – Sexual Health Clinics
resources.notes: County-run sexual health clinics serving Atlanta/Fulton residents with STI testing and treatment.

resources.name: AID Atlanta – HIV & STI Testing
resources.notes: Nonprofit HIV/STI testing and support. Penny can mention this as an additional community resource.

resources.name: Gateway Center – Warming Center
resources.notes: Frequently used as a winter warming center for people experiencing homelessness. Penny should remind users to check current activation status or call ahead.

resources.name: Central Park Recreation Center
resources.notes: City recreation center that opens as a temporary warming center during cold-weather activations.

resources.name: Old Adamsville Recreation Center
resources.notes: Another recreation center the City uses as a temporary warming center when severe cold is forecast.

trash_and_recycling.pickup_days: Varies by address. Residents should use the Solid Waste Services Collection Tool or ATL311 app to see their specific schedule.

resources.branch: Fulton County Library System – Central Library
resources.notes: Main hub of the public library system serving Atlanta and Fulton County. Great place for computer access, study space, and community programs.

resources.name: Central Park Recreation Center
resources.notes: Recreation center with community programming; also used as a warming center during extreme cold.

resources.name: Old Adamsville Recreation Center
resources.notes: Neighborhood recreation center that the City activates as a warming center when needed.
